create.title: Level-four Appell completion and moving-section source audit
create.statement_tex: For integer level four and tau in the upper half-plane, the Semikhatov-Taormina-Tipunin K_4 transformation and the equivalent completed A_4 Jacobi law apply to the pole-free moving section (nu,mu)=(tau/8,1/2-tau/8). The exact completion contains four theta times Mordell/nonholomorphic correction terms. The completed section is stabilized modulo exact elliptic shifts by Gamma(2), but the holomorphic part alone is not modular and the theorem supplies no square-root radial estimate. The double-cone expansion requiring |q|<|exp(2pi i(nu+mu))|<1 is inapplicable because the middle modulus equals one.
create.next_action: Use only the completed four-term Appell identity. Any analytic application must estimate all correction terms jointly with the periodized radial kernel.

create.title: Exact Appell completion and character-Poisson return of the one-sided divisor cone
create.statement_tex: For D(n)=sum_(hq=n,q odd,q>4h)chi_4(q), F(z)=sum_(n>=1)D(n)z^n=sum_(h>=1)z^(4h^2+h)/(1+z^(2h)). With z=exp(pi i tau), A_4(1/2,-3tau/2;tau)=K_4(tau,tau/8,1/2-tau/8)=1/2+2F(z). For compactly supported smooth w, the associated radial sum equals one half sum_h w(4h^2) plus (i/2)sum_(h>=1,j nonzero)chi_4(j){h^(-1)int_(4h^2)^infinity w(u)e(-ju/(4h))du-2w(4h^2)/(pi i j)}. For w(u)=V(u/N)u^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xu)), the positive-j interior stationary term is 2X^(-1/4)h^(-1)chi_4(j)V(4Xh^2/(j^2N))e(Xh/j-1/8). The boundary is target-safe, while the reciprocal signed cone and uniform entry/exit transitions remain open.
create.next_action: Attack the complete reciprocal-character cone with its stationary entry/exit and subtraction terms. Exploit the linear h-phase e(Xh/j), period-four character, and near-hyperbola variable |X-jm| without taking absolute values or silently returning to M1.

update.next_action: On the target-safe replacement range nu<=2/5, estimate the exact reciprocal-character Poisson cone including entry/exit and subtraction. The Appell completion is exact but supplies no standalone radial bound.

The remaining one-sided coefficient now has exact Appell and reciprocal-Poisson representations. Prove cancellation in the complete reciprocal cone; do not infer it from modular appearance or termwise stationary phase.

reject.reason: The exact object is a moving meromorphic level-four Appell section. Its completion has four correction terms, and no audited theorem controls their square-root radial convolution.
K_4(tau,0,1/2) pairs to an ordinary theta half-sum. The correct section is K_4(tau,tau/8,1/2-tau/8).
The exact level-four transformation contains four theta-Mordell/nonholomorphic terms; no cancellation identity removing them was proved.

Elementary Cauchy-Parseval returns N^(1/4+epsilon), and taking absolute values before periodization costs X^(1/4)N^(-1/2). These routes are not target-sized; the exact signed periodized pairing remains open.
That expansion requires |q|<|exp(2pi i(nu+mu))|<1, whereas exp(2pi i(nu+mu))=-1 here. Only the bilateral meromorphic definition and transformation apply.

no_change.reason: The reciprocal signed cone and the full lower-radial estimate remain open.
Round 63 proves transformations, not a new analytic bound or discrepancy exponent.
